result_scope_note: The direct S5 observation is limited to the membership/exile authority path. Catch caps, penalties, taxation, treasury disbursement and other operational laws are not credited as S5 merely because they are legislated.
vsm_interpretation: At the benchmark-defined society boundary, current members hold legitimate authority to ratify an executable membership rule; enactment changes membership and later rounds operate after that decision. This directly exercises S5 identity-policy authority for the composed benchmark society. The fixed sandbox, voting procedure, physics and API are benchmark/evaluation membrane constraints, and the result does not establish native S5 ownership or capability for any canonical Index harness or underlying model.
s5_boundary: benchmark-defined agent society at the current-membership recursion
